items.caption: This modern redraw shows three tall strokes rising from a curved base, with the central stroke extending below the side strokes. It presents 山 in a small-seal style, a later stylized form of the mountain pictograph.
items.alt: Three upright strokes rise from a curved base; the central stroke extends farther down than the side strokes.
items.selection_reason: The image makes the later seal-style shape visible and helps compare it with 山’s mountain-pictograph interpretation, while remaining clearly identified as a modern redraw.
items.period: Seal-script tradition; specimen date not established

limitations.text: This is a modern digital redraw, not an ancient inscription image. Its seal-script style is identified, but the image does not establish a specimen date or a continuous sequence of graphic changes.
